a fullwidth U does not fold to ASCII 'u', so the generated User-Agent is still added.
str.lower() on U+0130 yields two code points in both Python and Rust.
U+212A KELVIN SIGN lowercases to ASCII 'k' in both languages.
Rust applies the Greek final-sigma rule; Python does not. Only observable if it changed set membership, which it does not here.
a two-string tuple is truthy in Python even when both halves are empty, so `or None` does not collapse it.
